P1: The 石英高原 serves as the capital for the Pokémon League in the Johto and Kanto regions. This is where the Trainers who have defeated all eight Gym Leaders in either region battle against the Elite Four and the Champion. The entrance hall's lower level holds a Pokémon Center and a Poké Mart, allowing challengers to prepare themselves and their Pokémon for the gauntlet ahead. The Pokémon Wireless Club Union Room and the Pokémon Communication Club Colosseum are located on the middle level. The Elite Four is a group of talented Pokémon Trainers second only to the Champion in terms of power, and must be fought in succession with no break. These five battles will not be easy, but challengers who bring their strongest Pokémon and a healthy supply of Potions and Revives may finally find themselves in the Hall of Fame.
P2: The first member of the Elite Four is Will, a master of 超能力 Pokémon. Psychic-type moves are super effective against 格斗- and 毒 Pokémon, while Psychic-type Pokémon are weak to 虫-, 恶-, and 幽灵 moves.
P3: Both of Will's 天然鸟 can use 奇异之光 to harass their target. In addition to Ghost- and Dark-type moves, they both sustain serious damage from 电 attacks, as does his 呆壳兽. Its 瞬间失忆 move raises its 特防, so use physical moves to target its physical Defense, instead. Bug and Fire attacks work well against both 椰蛋树 and 迷唇姐.
P4: Defeating Will opens the door to the second room.
P5: The second member of the Elite Four is Koga, a master of 毒 Pokémon, and former Gym Leader from Kanto's 浅红市. Poison-type moves are super effective against 草 Pokémon, while Poison-type Pokémon are weak to 地面- and 超能力 moves.
P6: As Koga is a master ninja, his team makes use of poisoning and confusion to wear down their target. 超能力 attacks will be the most useful, as they deal serious damage to four of his five Pokémon. 岩石 moves are useful against his 阿利多斯, 摩鲁蛾, and 叉字蝠, and all three of his 虫 Pokémon are also vulnerable to 火 attacks. Watch out for 佛烈托斯' 大爆炸, and be sure to bring healing items to cure any Pokémon suffering from the effects of poison.
P7: Defeating Koga opens the door to the third room.
P8: The third member of the Elite Four is Bruno, a master of 格斗 Pokémon. Fighting-type moves are super effective against 恶-, 冰-, 一般-, 岩石-, and 钢 Pokémon, while Fighting-type Pokémon are weak to 飞行- and 超能力 moves.
P9: 超能力 attacks will do well against four of Bruno's five Pokémon. 飞行 attacks are equally useful, but 怪力 can fight back against Flying Pokémon with 岩崩. 快拳郎 can do the same with 冰冻拳 and 雷电拳. As a Ground Pokémon, not only is 大岩蛇 the only one of Bruno's team that is not 格斗 type, but it is also the only one to sustain massive damage from both 水- and 草 attacks.
P10: Defeating Bruno opens the door to the fourth room.
P11: The fourth member of the Elite Four is Karen, a master of 恶 Pokémon. Dark-type moves are super effective against 幽灵- and 超能力 Pokémon, while Dark-type Pokémon are weak to 虫- and 格斗 moves.
P12: With its high defenses and status moves to hinder its target, 月亮伊布 can be difficult to take down. If its 速度 is low enough to move second, 以牙还牙's power is doubled. 冰 moves are effective against 霸王花 and 黑暗鸦, while Murkrow and 黑鲁加 also take serious damage from 岩石 attacks. Use 幽灵- and 恶 moves against 耿鬼, but avoid using Dark Pokémon as it can retaliate with 真气弹.
P13: With the Elite Four defeated, the door to the Champion's room is unlocked. Only one person stands between you and the title of Champion!
P14: The final opponent turns out to be Lance, the same 龙 Pokémon master who helped defeat Team Rocket. Dragon-type moves are super effective against Dragon-type Pokémon, while Dragon-type Pokémon are weak to Dragon- and 冰 moves.
P15: Lance begins with his 暴鲤龙, which takes massive damage from 电 attacks. 喷火龙 has the same problem with 岩石 moves, while both it and 化石翼龙 take serious damage from 水 attacks. His three 快龙 each have a powerful move—打雷, 暴风雪, and 大字爆炎—to help cover the team's vulnerabilities. However, as Flying Pokémon, they fare poorly in the cold and sustain massive damage from 冰 attacks. All of his Dragonite can use 破坏光线, so be sure to bring plenty of HP-restoring items!
P16: Lance congratulates you for defeating the Pokémon League, and compliments you on growing so much with your Pokémon. He is soon interrupted by DJ Mary, who rushes in for an interview. She would have been here sooner, but Professor Oak is not as quick as he was in his younger days. He applauds your victory, saying that your Pokémon won because they believed in you as a Trainer. Mary tries again for an interview, but Lance steps in and leads you to the next room.
P17: The Hall of Fame is where all victorious Trainers and their dedicated Pokémon will be recorded, as a testament to their power and perseverance. Lance remarks that it has been a long time sine he was last here, and goes on to explain the large machine. He then activates it, officially recording both you and your Pokémon as the latest inductees into the Hall of Fame.
P18: The game is saved, a slideshow of your victorious Pokémon plays, and the credits roll.
